correctness.rationale: Every algebra endomorphism is uniquely (F,Q), since the local radical has cube zero. Commuting retractions on the radical are commuting idempotent block matrices with diagonal (F_i,F_i tensor F_i). The algebra of commuting projection operators is isomorphic to the product of 2^k copies of the base field in every characteristic; the radical-layer extension therefore splits. The splitting is realized by an actual algebra automorphism, leaving exactly q^(d^3-H) possible quadratic correction tuples. Counting simultaneous eigenspace decompositions gives the GL-quotient factor, and intersections follow by products of commuting projections. Exhaustive binary direct-composition and larger-prime constraint-rank tests independently verify small cases; these finite checks are not substituted for proof.
